tickers.headline: Green-shoot 2-of-3 FIRED on its own legs — anchored RAISE, Rank-1 reversal +6.3pp, accelerating exit rate. B/S watch shifts to receivables.
Consultant count flat since October 2025 — the metric that led the collapse has stopped falling; profit hasn't turned yet.
FY26 PBT £12.5m beats the cut consensus by 21% inside a 5% down year; Fuels' rescue was oil-price timing, not margin.
FY27 guided above consensus — but the FY26 upgrade run stops at a held >£40m as Demand Flexibility economics reset.
tickers.next_test: H1 results 22 Sep 2026 — DF economics quantified, CEO successor named

tickers.headline: Record FY25 everywhere — but the margin engine has stopped climbing, and Anpario has quietly stopped printing volumes and prices.
tickers.next_test: 9 Sep 2026 interims — the printed H1 gross margin, and whether volumes and prices reappear.

tickers.headline: FY25 record — revenue +34%, EBITDA +42%, margin 29.6%, organic re-accelerated to 15.3%; the only shadow is a funded £24.1m net-debt swing.
tickers.trigger: Green-shoot condition 1 only (single condition, no 2-of-3): organic +2.3pp and four consecutive 🟢↗ revenue growth accelerations. ⛔ Tier-1 balance-sheet flag: net cash→net debt crossover (first H1 25, £24.1m at FY25), acquisition-funded and covenant-clean.
tickers.next_test: H1 26 organic vs 17%; net debt vs Kvadrant's £18m envelope; whether a quantified guide — or the H1 TU — returns.

tickers.headline: H1-26 delivers organic revenue and profit growth (+10% PBT) — the turn is now in the numbers; Middle East the one live H2 drag.
tickers.next_test: 22 Sep H1 results confirming £10.6m PBT and organic-positive holding, plus a Middle East H2 read

tickers.headline: Volume came back in an unreported second half; price didn't — and the FY26 doubling hasn't been revised since November.
tickers.trigger: 3 of 3 fired under the 2-of-3 rule: Hard/G (two guide cuts + margin compression) + Text (two consecutive -3) + Drift (FY25 year-end update not issued)
tickers.next_test: H1 FY26 interims, late Sept 2026 — first reported test of a 31% revenue step.

tickers.headline: Guide lifted to "tracking ahead" after one quarter — orders +31% organic, book-to-bill 1.15; first multi-signal green since recovery began
tickers.trigger: 2-of-3: Condition 1 (G-RAISE, Buy/Sell RNS) + Condition 2 (Text 🟢🟢, falling-to-rising 2 consecutive prints)
tickers.next_test: H1 FY27 TU (Oct-26): organic orders Q2 ≥+10%? Controls organic sales positive? Proforma gearing tracking to 1.8x?

tickers.headline: Revenue turned down in the latest half while profit and margin held — one leg each way, neither side converging to an alert.
tickers.trigger: Deterioration 1 of 3 — parent-vs-latest-sub-period divergence only (v3.16; print-corroborated at Rank 4 by the Mar-26 TU, watch-flagged at Rank 1). Text did not fire. Drift did not fire: the ADAM Audio candidate is not a ledger metric, is qualitative not blank, and is explained. Green-shoot mirror 1 of 3. No alert. Audited 28 Jul 2026: prior Drift leg withdrawn, five grid/trail cells corrected, no arrow changed.
tickers.next_test: H1 FY27 (six months to Aug-26): Content Creation above £63.6m, and whether gross margin holds above 45%.

tickers.headline: Leading KPIs confirmed lower at the interims while profit beat its own three-week-old estimate; guide held a third time — the raises have stopped.
tickers.trigger: 2-of-3 deterioration: Hard (leading-rank deceleration, 3 prints) + Text (08-Jul-26 −1, first H2-lean); Drift clean
tickers.next_test: Oct-26 Q3 TU: broker model needs a ~£1.2m Q3 ARR add — the test is now consensus-anchored.

tickers.headline: FY26 beats consensus on revenue & profit; "exceed" FY27 guide issued; all three divisions grow; quality of earnings improving.
tickers.trigger: 2 of 3 green-shoot: Hard (rev + PBT growing 2+ prints + consensus beat) + Text (2 consecutive up-scores from trough); G RAISE on Buy/Sell RNS; Drift green shoots (OB re-quantified, 3-division disclosure expansion)
tickers.next_test: H1 FY27 TU (Oct/Nov-26) & H1 R (Dec-26): OB >£90m; margin >7%; CAIN follow-on order; guide tone; AI component cost pressure vs opportunity.

tickers.headline: Guide cut twice, but the second half turned: revenue grew, the profit decline shrank to a tenth, order book up 49%.
tickers.trigger: 3 of 3 deterioration conditions fired (two G cuts including the latest RNS; language at or below -1 for five consecutive prints; organic revenue growth and the UK market benchmark withheld against established FY-TU cadence). Green-shoot mirror fires 2 of 3. Direction held at watch because the parent-vs-latest-sub-period rule hands governance to H2 FY26, which beats the FY26 print by 19.1pp on profit.
tickers.next_test: Sep-2026 results: operating margin, organic growth, and the order book's stated basis.

tickers.headline: First guidance cut in four years was itself missed; latest AGM withholds its usual H1 sales figure while claiming expectations unchanged.
tickers.trigger: Hard/G decline + explicit guidance CUT (condition 1) and language falling from repeated highs to -3 (condition 2) = 2-of-3; Drift AGM-disclosure withhold corroborates as watch-flag.
tickers.next_test: H1 FY26 results (~Sep-26) must show organic revenue and adjusted EBITDA growth resuming to break the down-cycle.

tickers.headline: Order books refilling hard and the FY27 guide reaffirmed — but profit's 71% off its FY24 peak and the recovery is management's own back-half promise, unproven.
tickers.trigger: 2 of 3 technically met (Hard: margin compression; Text) — operator-discounted, no alert
tickers.next_test: Nov-26 H1: does H1 FY27 PBT confirm guided weak-then-recover, or undershoot £12–15m?

tickers.headline: Fourth straight guide raise since Jan-25; FY26 PBT ≈£98m, moderately ahead of consensus; China JV proceeds cut leverage to ~0.4x.
tickers.trigger: green-shoot mirror 2-of-3 (guide-raise sequence + rising language; balance-sheet mirror outside the count)
tickers.next_test: FY26 prelim (10-Sep-26): resume China royalty-customer count, give H2 PIC/ABS splits, set pro-forma post-deconsolidation FY27 base.

tickers.headline: Order-book disclosure and sequential revenue have turned up before the P&L — FY26's £1.93m trading loss is the printed bottom to test, not the direction.
tickers.trigger: deterioration 3-of-3 (printed: Hard + Text/G + Drift) + green mirror 2-of-3 (live: sequential revenue + disclosure resumption)
tickers.next_test: FY27 H1 (Nov-26): does revenue growth convert to a pre-exceptional operating profit, or does NRE-mix keep trading negative? Watch dividend cover.
